data.body: **[P2] Avoid propagating invocation sampling as the operation's decision.** In execution view, `operationContexts` contains deferred placeholders whose flags come from the Invocation span. The supported global-provider path allows a replacement sampler to decide independently per span. If that sampler drops `Invocation` but samples `invoke`, this collector sends `Sampled=0` even though the eventual invoke span is sampled, causing a child using the SDK's sampling logic to drop its durable spans. Emit metadata only when the operation's sampling decision is authoritative; otherwise abstain. Add coverage with a replacement sampler that makes different invocation and invoke decisions.
